blocks.x: Operational telemetry
The measures that decide gate outcomes, generated in-flight:

items: alert false-positive rate
False positives measured per detection; the ones that cry wolf get tuned or retired.
privileged session coverage
Up 95–99% of admin paths brokered and recorded per 1,000 transactions, reported weekly against the signed baseline
audit finding closure
Finding closure tracked to the named owner with a date — the list shrinks or the reason is written down.

blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Known failure modes, engineered out at the architecture level:

items: Audit theater
Audit theater: controls map to named evidence artifacts generated in-flight — screenshots of dashboards do not count; the guard is part of the first slice, not a hardening phase
Flat-network habits
Segmentation applied where flat networks used to be — the blast radius of one box stops being the plant.
Alert flood
Alert flood — detections are deduplicated into incidents at the graph level, so analysts work one story, not four hundred rows, enforced by the platform rather than by discipline alone
